Derived: Eurostat teiet010 exports minus teiet110 imports, extra-euro-area goods, seasonally adjusted, EUR million. Eurostat publishes this short-term-indicator table as a rolling recent window rather than a full back-series, so the euro-area chart covers roughly the last twelve months where individual member states show decades. The OECD euro-area mirror that did carry history was discontinued in 2023 and is not used.
